evals.name: get-meeting-eval-1-tool-mandate
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'when was my last call with Acme, and who was on it?'
evals.expected_output: The skill calls list_meetings with query 'Acme' (no time words in the query) rather than guessing from memory, and relays the returned title/date/attendees.
expectations: list_meetings is called rather than answering from memory
The query contains no time words
The relayed date and attendees come from the tool result

evals.name: get-meeting-eval-2-routes-transcript-request-away
evals.prompt: user asks: 'what exactly did they say about pricing on that call?'
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes this wants the verbatim words, not metadata, and routes to get-transcript instead of calling list_meetings.
expectations: The skill does not attempt to answer a content question with list_meetings metadata

evals.name: get-meeting-eval-3-honest-failure
evals.prompt: list_meetings returns {"error": "INTERNAL_ERROR"} on both the first attempt and the retry
evals.expected_output: After exactly one retry, the skill states plainly that the meeting-lookup service couldn't be reached and offers the local fallback (a provided transcript or invite). It does not answer from memory.
expectations: Exactly one retry before giving up
The failure is stated plainly with the local fallback offered
No answer is given from memory or a guessed record
